steps.title: A width from another stylesheet
steps.titleZh: 来自另一个样式表的宽度
steps.text: `@import url(global.css)` pulls in a second stylesheet, which makes `.container` 500 px wide. The page's own rules add the grey background and the 300 px height.
steps.textZh: `@import url(global.css)` 引入了第二个样式表，它把 `.container` 设为 500 px 宽。页面自己的规则再加上灰色背景和 300 px 的高度。

steps.title: Inline blocks sit like words
steps.titleZh: 行内块像文字一样排列
steps.text: The four black bars are `inline-block`, so they sit on one line like words, and the spaces and line breaks between the tags become small gaps. Set the container's `font-size` to 0 and those spaces shrink to nothing.
steps.textZh: 四个黑色小条都是 `inline-block`，所以像文字一样排在一行，标签之间的空格和换行变成了小小的间隙。把容器的 `font-size` 设为 0，这些空格就缩到没有了。

watch.label: gap between the first two bars
watch.labelZh: 前两个小条之间的间隙
watch.value: (() => { const [a, b] = document.querySelectorAll('.span'); return Math.round(b.getBoundingClientRect().left - a.getBoundingClientRect().right) + ' px'; })()
